messages.author: 899807b9b89eb68c
messages.subject: Differential PTM level analysis
parts:
Hello everyone.

MSstats make it easy to perform analyses of differential protein abundances.

Would a kind soul share an example of how to modify the conventional use of MSstats to analyse phospho-enriched samples?

I understand that it is possible because it has been conceptually mentioned before.

I am hoping to see one example and I will be very grateful.

Thank you.

Ivan

messages.author: 255c094891ed6895
messages.subject: Re: Differential PTM level analysis
parts:
The primary thing that you need is instead of having a column with protein ID, it needs to be a protein ID with a phosphorylation site, this way the sites are kept separate, instead of being grouped as a protein.  We use artMS r-package, which can take MaxQuant output, convert to a site based input file for MSstats, and then run MSstats.  http://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/artMS.html

-Danielle
